checklist_item_collapsing.items_1_and_2: one check - every citation must be among the chunk_ids supplied to this generation call, never checked against global corpus existence
checklist_item_collapsing.items_3_and_6: same citation-validity check applied to whatever citations are present; zero-citation answers are never blocked (see missing_citation_policy)
checklist_item_collapsing.item_4: check_structured_numeric_output is Task 4.8's check_xbrl_context() re-exported unchanged - no separate generation step exists for the structured route
checklist_item_collapsing.item_5: reuses src.router.rules.ADVICE_KEYWORDS verbatim, no new keyword set

missing_citation_policy: no missing_citation reason code implemented - resolved from this task's own 'do not require a citation for a legitimate abstention unless the roadmap explicitly says otherwise' rule (roadmap does not) plus src.eval.citation_integrity.evaluate_citation_integrity's own precedent that abstention-expectation cannot be inferred from answer text alone
failure_policy: reject the entire answer on any citation problem (unknown or malformed) - mirrors evaluate_citation_integrity's PASS-iff-zero-reasons precedent, never a partial strip-and-keep

routes_integrated.structured_xbrl: function implemented and portably tested, no existing generation orchestrator to wire into (same honest scoping as Task 4.8)
routes_integrated.navigation: not in scope - PROJECT_EXECUTION.md's Task 4.9 checklist does not mention navigation-route output validation

known_limitation_advice_detection_gap: ADVICE_KEYWORDS is phrased first-person ('should i buy') for user-question detection; second-person model output ('you should buy') is not caught - verified by test and documented, not hidden
known_limitations: No missing-citation/groundedness-on-absence check - deliberate, documented non-decision
Advice detection reuses a first-person keyword list; second-person model-output phrasing is not caught
Citation validity inherits detect_citation_attempts()'s existing scope (ASCII/fullwidth brackets with chunk-shaped content only)
Output guard integration proven for the dense route only - structured-route function has no existing orchestrator to wire into
Structural citation validity is a proxy for groundedness, not a factual-entailment guarantee - no LLM judge was used or is claimed
